dedupe_keys.name: stanford parallel lithium ion cell imbalance experiments

description: This collection records a full-factorial experiment on parallel-connected lithium-ion battery modules at Stanford Energy Control Laboratory. Fifty-four conditions vary temperature, cell-to-cell interconnection resistance, chemistry and ageing. The team measures module voltage and current alongside individual branch currents and cell temperatures, with separate characterization of Samsung NCA and LG NMC cells. Repository documentation states one-second logging during module experiments. Mendeley version 2 lists 194 MATLAB and Excel files, free under CC BY 4.0. Coverage is controlled laboratory configurations, not field battery systems or a common multi-year service record. Fixed charging and discharge procedures limit direct transfer to arbitrary storage dispatch. A reviewer-assessed use is calibrating cell-imbalance or thermal-response components in battery simulations. model-system-advisor-model-sam is a related system-level storage tool, although it operates at a different modelling scale. No binary file was downloaded and no current-distribution model was tested.
